run_planner_service: run the Pyro4 planner service daemon that registers the Planner object on the robot's name server
create_Planner: create a Planner instance with a SLAM proxy to compute short-term goals using FMM path planning
get_short_term_goal: get a short-term goal from the Planner given a robot location and a target goal or goal map
goal_within_threshold: check if the robot is within a distance and angle threshold of its goal using the Planner
is_traversable: check if a given map location is traversable by looking up the traversable map grid
